Name: Chest Terminal
Author: NingLin
Description:
本模组由bilibili-up主柠娜制作。
该模组添加了四个物品(可通过制作台制作)： 
箱子终端：箱子贴在一起自动互联，打开终端统一管理所有箱中物品，也可用任意小径连接其他箱子。支持搜索、排序、取出/存入。 
无线终端：无线访问所有箱子终端。 
终端输入器: 通过设置频道 设置过滤项 从周围的箱子中取出物品到对应频道的箱子终端中(有速率控制)。 
终端输出器： 通过设置频道 设置过滤项 从对应频道的箱子终端中取出物品到周围的箱子中(有速率控制)。 
快速提交bug : 1971261756@qq.com(只接受最新版本的bug提交。请提供复现过程)



This mod adds four items (craftable via the crafting table):
[b]Chest Terminal:[/b] Chests placed adjacent to each other automatically interconnect. Opening the terminal allows unified management of all items in connected chests. You can also use small paths to connect other chests. Supports searching, sorting, and item withdrawal/deposit.
[b]Wireless Terminal:[/b] Wirelessly access all Chest Terminals.
[b]Terminal Inputer:[/b] By setting a channel and filter, it extracts items from nearby chests and sends them into the Chest Terminal network of the corresponding channel (with rate control).
[b]Terminal Outputer:[/b] By setting a channel and filter, it extracts items from the Chest Terminal network of the corresponding channel and outputs them to nearby chests (with rate control).
[b]Bug report email:[/b][email=1971261756@qq.com]1971261756@qq.com[/email] (Only bug reports from the latest version are accepted. Please provide reproduction steps.)
